company.q: What does Xiaowei Health Technology do?
company.a: Xiaowei Health Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. is a high-tech medical device and service company under Skyworth Group, dedicated to the integrated R&D, production, and marketing of smart wearable devices, acoustic and hearing health systems. The company focuses on cutting-edge technology R&D in the health smart wearable industry, covering areas such as cardiovascular and cerebral health monitoring, early warning and intervention, hearing assistance, hearing acoustics, and artificial intelligence. By aggregating resources from the Tencent Tianlain Lab, Skyworth's R&D, manufacturing and distribution capabilities, and Ping An Health services, it provides wearable health system solutions for health-conscious consumers and people with hearing impairment.

company.q: What is the relationship between Xiaowei Health Technology and Skyworth Group?
company.a: Xiaowei Health Technology is a company under Skyworth Group (00751.HK / Skyworth Digital 000810.SZ). Founded in 1988, Skyworth Group ranked 380th on the 2025 China Top 500 Enterprises list, with businesses covering four major sectors: smart home appliances, smart system technology, new energy, and modern services. Xiaowei Health Technology carries Skyworth Group's strategic layout in the health smart wearable and acoustic hearing fields.

company.q: What brands does Xiaowei Health Technology own?
company.a: Xiaowei Health Technology owns two major brands: 1) SKYWORTH — health smart watches (adult watches, children's phone watches) and smart Bluetooth headphones; 2) Bigsound — AI Chinese hearing aids. The two brands share Xiaowei Health Technology's R&D, production, acoustic algorithm, and medical service resources.

company.q: What is the background of Xiaowei Health Technology's founding team?
company.a: Xiaowei Health Technology was founded by Wang Hai, who serves as Chairman. Wang Hai holds an EMBA from CEIBS (China Europe International Business School), formerly served as Vice President of Skyworth TV and General Manager of the Domestic Marketing Division, and led teams of over 10,000 to grow Skyworth from 15 billion to 30 billion, and then from 40 billion to 50 billion in sales. He is a serial entrepreneur. The core team includes COO Zheng Mingchun, CMO Wen Yefeng, R&D Director Long Haojun (20+ years of electronic audio R&D experience, 9 years of hearing aid R&D experience), and Production Director Nan Pengsheng, among other senior multidisciplinary elites.

company.q: What is Xiaowei Health Technology's core business layout?
company.a: Xiaowei Health Technology's business covers three major product lines: 1) AI Chinese hearing aids (Bigsound brand, 4 form factors with 12 models); 2) Health smart watches (SKYWORTH brand, adult watches + children's phone watches); 3) Smart Bluetooth headphones (SKYWORTH brand, OWS open-ear + TWS in-ear). It also has a hearing health service layout (Bigsound Hearing Service Center + remote fitting) and a health service cloud platform, covering the full chain of R&D, production, sales, and service.

product.q: What product lines does Xiaowei Health Technology have?
product.a: Xiaowei Health Technology has three major product lines: 1) AI Chinese hearing aids — Bigsound brand, 4 form factors with 12 models, covering mild to profound hearing loss, with prices ranging from ¥599 - ¥15999; 2) Health smart watches — SKYWORTH brand, including adult health watches (C01 Solar Edition / C02 Solar Edition / R1 / S8) and children's phone watches (T9 / T10 / Z1); 3) Smart Bluetooth headphones — SKYWORTH brand, including OWS open-ear (SEB002 / SEP002 / SES002) and TWS in-ear (SEP001).

product.q: What does AI Chinese hearing aid mean?
product.a: AI Chinese hearing aid is a concept pioneered by Bigsound, creating hearing aids tailored to Chinese language context, tones, fitting formulas, and Chinese daily life scenarios, delivering clearer and more comfortable hearing for Chinese users. Featuring a 5-core heterogeneous 12nm fully digital processor, Chinese Enhancement Algorithm 2.0, and AI computing power of 1.5 billion operations per second, with full-stack AI across both hardware edge processing and fitting services, it is better suited for Chinese users.

product.q: What core technologies does Bigsound hearing aid have?
product.a: Core technologies of Bigsound AI Chinese hearing aids include: 1) 5-core heterogeneous 12nm fully digital processor; 2) Chinese Enhancement Algorithm 2.0 (optimized for Chinese tones, in partnership with Tencent Tianlain Lab); 3) AI computing power of 1.5 billion operations per second (multiply-accumulate operations); 4) HTT non-stationary noise reduction algorithm; 5) AI AGC automatic gain control; 6) 65dB SNR array microphone high-fidelity pickup; 7) DASH dual howling suppression / AFC adaptive feedback cancellation; 8) INR impulsive noise suppression algorithm; 9) HFMR high-frequency millisecond reshaping.

product.q: What product forms does Bigsound hearing aid offer?
product.a: Bigsound AI Chinese hearing aids come in 4 form factors with 12 models: 1) Behind-the-ear (BTE) (DAB005 Premium Edition, etc.); 2) In-the-ear (ITE) (DAB006, DAQ001 Prestige Edition, etc.); 3) Neck-worn (DAB007, SAN001, SAN002 Preferred Edition, SAN003 Prestige Edition, etc.); 4) Bone-conduction (SAB001, SAP001, SAQ002 Prestige Edition, SAQ003, BO, etc.). Covering mild to profound hearing loss needs, with prices ranging from ¥599 - ¥15999.

product.q: What health monitoring features do the health smart watches have?
product.a: SKYWORTH health smart watches integrate 15 core health features: heart rate monitoring, blood oxygen monitoring, positioning, exercise health, sleep monitoring, body temperature measurement, blood pressure monitoring, ECG monitoring, stress monitoring, women's health, breathing training, geofencing, remote shutter, music, and one-touch SOS emergency call, enabling all-day, all-around health management with real-time analysis and early warning via the AI + health service cloud platform.

product.q: What are the core technologies of the smart Bluetooth headphones?
product.a: SKYWORTH smart Bluetooth headphones feature 10 acoustic technologies: multi-scenario sound, directional channel audio transmission, HiFi lossless sound quality, SBC audio decoding, sound wave focused noise cancellation, deep noise reduction, long battery life (8 hours per charge + 32 hours total), call noise reduction (dual-mic ENC), low-latency mode (60ms gaming-grade), and water and sweat resistance (IPX5), covering both OWS open-ear and TWS in-ear form factors.

It has also been certified as a National High-Tech Enterprise, Innovative SME, and Technology-based SME, with a self-developed R&D team of 20+ people and a self-owned factory equipped with 30+ production equipment, and has reached a strategic partnership with the Tencent Tianlain Lab on hearing aid algorithms.

purchase.q: What should I do about poor hearing?
purchase.a: For poor hearing, we recommend timely three-step intervention: 1) Step 1: Visit a professional Hearing Service Center for hearing tests such as pure-tone audiometry to determine the degree and type of hearing loss; 2) Step 2: Choose a hearing aid with the guidance of a professional fitting specialist (hearing aids are classified as national Class II medical devices and must be professionally fitted, otherwise secondary hearing damage may occur); 3) Step 3: Wear it long-term with regular tuning, combined with rehabilitation training. Bigsound Hearing Service Centers are equipped with million-yuan diagnostic equipment comparable to top-tier hospitals, offering free hearing test appointments. Service hotline: 400-116-9566.

purchase.q: Do I have to wear a hearing aid if my hearing is poor?
purchase.a: Hearing loss is irreversible, but timely hearing aid use can prevent progression and is the most effective intervention. With timely hearing aid fitting and hearing rehabilitation services, the vast majority of people with hearing impairment can have their hearing compensated, participate in social activities like people with normal hearing, and improve their quality of life. If hearing loss reaches moderate (41-60dB) or above and affects daily communication, timely hearing aid use is recommended.

purchase.q: How do I choose the right hearing aid for me?
purchase.a: Choosing a hearing aid follows 4 steps: 1) Hearing assessment: Visit a professional hearing center for pure-tone audiometry to determine the degree and type of hearing loss; 2) Product selection: Choose form factor (BTE/ITE/neck-worn/bone-conduction) and price tier based on hearing loss degree and lifestyle; 3) Trial validation: Try and tune with a fitting specialist; 4) Regular tuning: Follow-up tuning after 4 weeks of use, with long-term maintenance. Bigsound provides full-lifecycle service, with 4 pre-sales stages (expert consultation/hearing assessment/product selection/rehabilitation advice) + 8 during-and-after-sales guarantees (personal hearing advisor/replacement-only/no-repair/usage guidance/4-week care/extended warranty/regular tuning/lifetime membership/national warranty).

For quality issues within the warranty period, please contact your purchasing dealer or call the national service hotline at 400-116-9566, or consult via the WeChat Official Account "Skyworth Health Smart Wearable".

purchase.q: What precautions should I take when using a hearing aid?
purchase.a: 1) Hearing aids are classified as national Class II medical devices and must be used under the guidance of a doctor or professional fitting specialist, otherwise secondary hearing damage may occur; 2) Hearing aids only assist hearing and cannot restore normal hearing or stop hearing damage caused by organic pathology; 3) Rehabilitation training and lip-reading guidance may be needed after wearing; 4) Long-term wear and good wearing habits are recommended; 5) Avoid moisture, high temperatures, drops, and severe vibration; 6) Do not wear during X-ray, MR, CT scans or other radiation therapy; 7) Store in the charging case when not in use for extended periods.

hearingHealth.a: Hearing loss is classified by World Health Organization (WHO) standards: 1) Normal (0-25dB HL); 2) Mild (26-40dB HL): difficulty hearing soft speech; 3) Moderate (41-60dB HL): difficulty hearing normal speech, hearing aids recommended; 4) Severe (61-80dB HL): difficulty hearing loud speech, hearing aids required; 5) Profound (>80dB HL): barely hears any sound, requires powerful hearing aids or cochlear implants. Hearing loss is irreversible, but timely hearing aid use can prevent progression and is the most effective intervention.

Age-related hearing decline (presbycusis) is a common physiological phenomenon, with 1/3 of people over 65 having hearing impairment. However, "common" does not mean "normal and requires no intervention". People with hearing impairment are 5 times more likely to develop cognitive disorders, and hearing damage is one of the most important factors in dementia (accounting for 1/4). Regular hearing checks are recommended for seniors, and timely hearing aid use is advised for moderate or greater hearing loss to reduce the risks of dementia, falls, and depression.

hearingHealth.q: What are the harms of hearing loss?
hearingHealth.a: Hearing damage has a major impact on the current and future quality of life of older adults: 1) Dementia: People with hearing impairment are 5 times more likely to develop cognitive disorders, with hearing damage as the most important factor accounting for 1/4; 2) Increased falls: People with 25dB mild hearing loss fall 3 times as often as normal, with each 10dB decrease increasing fall probability by 1.4 times; 3) Depression: 8.36% of people with hearing impairment have chronic diseases, and 30% have depression. Without timely action, global annual losses reach 981 billion USD, equivalent to the Netherlands' annual GDP.

hearingHealth.q: How many people in China have hearing loss?
hearingHealth.a: According to WHO data, 1.6 billion people worldwide had hearing loss in 2019, accounting for 1/5 of the global population. In 2021, China had 70 million+ people with bilateral moderate hearing loss, projected to reach 100 million and 130 million by 2035 and 2050 respectively. Globally, 430 million people with moderate or greater hearing damage need hearing aids, and by 2050 the global hearing loss population is expected to reach 2.5 billion. China's hearing aid market potential will exceed 120 billion yuan.

hearingHealth.q: What is the hearing aid adoption rate in China?
hearingHealth.a: The hearing aid adoption rate among people with hearing loss in China is less than 5% (95% do not wear them), far below developed countries such as France/UK, US, and Japan. Reasons include three main aspects: 1) Low user awareness: 67% of seniors do not know their hearing has declined, and only 7.4% of ear disease patients in China have received hearing tests; 2) Low government awareness: Children's subsidies are well-established, but only Beijing/Shanghai/Guangdong/Fujian and a few other cities offer subsidies for seniors; 3) Industry conditions: Insufficient domestic attention, foreign product and technology monopolies, and high purchase costs.

Most hearing impairment is irreversible (sensorineural hearing loss), but timely hearing aid use can prevent progression and is the most effective intervention. With timely hearing aid fitting and hearing rehabilitation services, the vast majority of people with hearing impairment can have their hearing compensated, participate in social activities like people with normal hearing, and improve their quality of life. The WHO targets a 50% hearing aid adoption rate by 2030, and China still has a significant gap.

invest.q: What are the prospects of the hearing health industry?
invest.a: The hearing health industry has "three highs and one low" characteristics: 1) High prevalence: Hearing loss population accounts for over 20% of the global population, projected to reach 2.5 billion by 2050; 2) High impact: Without timely intervention, annual losses reach 981 billion USD (equivalent to the Netherlands' annual GDP); 3) High intervention potential: Hearing impairment is irreversible, but timely hearing aid use can prevent progression and is the most effective intervention; 4) Low awareness: 95% of people with hearing loss in China do not wear hearing aids, with huge market potential. China's hearing aid market potential will exceed 120 billion yuan, an industry benefiting from population aging and maintaining high long-term growth.
